svg.title: PHI review: the decision process, stage by stage
svg.text: PHI review: what happens to a document packet

g.text: the LLM fills a typed schema of candidate spans: names, dates,
ages, places, contacts, codes, unique characteristics, terms;
regexes add the cheap ones (phones, emails, ZIPs, study codes)

svg.text: code, not the LLM, chooses the questions: whose · date_role · code_kind · geo_level
evaluator: cheapest first, so a pattern answer is preferred over an LLM call

g.text: builds a profile of each subject from every document: names,
birth dates, record numbers, each citing the document it came from
BiomedicalTerm (general rules and their exceptions are both proposed)
safe-harbor: guards first, then the most specific rule wins
conservative: guards first, then the most protective rule wins
each decision: rule, CFR citation, evidence and its source document,
and every rule that competed for the span, in policy order
